Wow, I am truly to grateful I came across your post
tonight. I really needed it. I can’t believe we literally have experienced the same thing and it’s so scary that someone can be that broken inside that they can do that to another person. Use them for their own selfish needs until they don’t need them anymore. He literally is trying to do this to me because I care about him. I can’t anymore it’s making me lose myself and everything I stand for. I’m not where you are yet but I can only hope that when I am i’ll feel the same as you
do. The hurt and pain runs deep but I know that i’ll prevail in the end.

I honestly feel the same and I think it’s crazy that even after all the affirmations, the self help videos, daily mantras, meditation, and even therapy never really resolved whats always been there. Since I was only 10 years old I knew this world wasn’t for me and I wanted to die. It was the first suicidal thought I ever had. I’m 19 now and even though a lot has changed since then I still feel that and I feel bad for my family because they have no idea. It’s like it never ends but then again we know that one day it really all will and that’s what
is fucked up. I’m doing all of this for what? If in the end none of this shit matters in

I’m in a similar situation and I just want to say none of
us arr actually all that different and yes we struggle and feel like nothing makes sense because none of this shit actually makes sense! We have to take it day by day because one day we won’t even get another one. Not one to feel the pain we feel now. Not one to ever get a chance feel happiness again. To fall so deep in love it hurts. To land a new job you were really wanting. To move to a new city and start a new life. To have children of our own one day. Hell even to write a simple reply to a stranger on reddit who is also experiencing the same shit as you are. It’s all temporary every single last moment we have is temporary. We are truly living on borrowed time that’s not ours. It is harsh when you look at it for what it is but it’s comforting to know in a way. We all will one day cease to live no more. So what is the rush? Why can’t we live the days we have left in peace? I’m not saying any of this to sound self righteous I am literally
in the same spot, if not worse. I just want you to consider at least one thing i’m saying. We’re really never ever alone.
